title: Qualify immutable local NuGet publisher for two-dependency Math Standard package in a disposable feed
commitMessage: test: qualify Standard immutable local NuGet publisher rehearsal

contribution.summary: Qualify a Standard private NuGet publisher controller by packaging unchanged sources with two exact dependencies and rehearsing no-overwrite publication in a disposable feed.
contribution.value: Reuse Dw.Tools.NuGet to pack a real Standard archive with pinned base and Expression packages, verify archive/DLL and nuspec identities, collision, altered-digest and cancellation refusals, and run ten source-free binary checks.
debtChanges: RS142 verifies a disposable publisher rehearsal only; a physical NUGET_LOCAL release of the exact original RS141 archive requires a separate explicit owner action.
A newly packed rehearsal package may differ byte-for-byte from the qualified RS141 candidate; its SHA must never be substituted for that original immutable source.
Source versions, two original ProjectReference edges, RS137-RS141 receipts and published prerequisite archives remain unchanged; no public package license is selected.
Installed-package rollback, crash recovery, concurrent publisher assurance, other RID compatibility and Discovery/Decision integration remain unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After RS142 is pushed, review the exact 13604-byte RS141 candidate and private rights; separately run guarded Standard --publish and --verify modes, then qualify actual shared-feed readback under DWF before further dependent releases.
